movements_income_outcome_shape_check.name: movements_income_outcome_shape_check
movements_income_outcome_shape_check.value:
"movements"."type" NOT IN ('income', 'outcome') OR (
				"movements"."category_id" IS NOT NULL
				AND "movements"."destination_account_id" IS NULL
				AND "movements"."destination_amount" IS NULL
				AND "movements"."exchange_rate" IS NULL
			)

movements_transfer_shape_check.name: movements_transfer_shape_check
movements_transfer_shape_check.value:
"movements"."type" <> 'transfer' OR (
				"movements"."category_id" IS NULL
				AND "movements"."destination_account_id" IS NOT NULL
				AND "movements"."destination_account_id" <> "movements"."account_id"
				AND "movements"."destination_amount" IS NOT NULL
			)

mp_import_rules_shape_check.name: mp_import_rules_shape_check
mp_import_rules_shape_check.value: ("mp_import_rules"."type" = 'transfer' AND "mp_import_rules"."counter_account_id" IS NOT NULL AND "mp_import_rules"."category_id" IS NULL) OR ("mp_import_rules"."type" <> 'transfer' AND "mp_import_rules"."category_id" IS NOT NULL)
